verdict.rationale: Gumloop provides REST API, Python/JS SDKs, webhook triggers, scheduled triggers, and API key authentication that together enable headless/CI-driven runs of agents without the UI. However, evidence is all first-party docs with no independent CI/automation case study, no CLI tool for CI pipelines, and no explicit mention of exit codes, CI-specific integration guides, or GitHub Actions examples. missing for 10: dedicated CLI/CI integration guide, independent verification of headless runs, GitHub Actions or CI pipeline examples, exit-code/status handling for automation.
